notes: Access: allmodern.com blocks plain requests (HTTP 429 PerimeterX) but is fully reachable via curl_cffi impersonate=safari17_0 (same access route documented for this company in notes/201.md); chrome131 stayed blocked on the homepage. robots.txt has no Claude-specific disallow (only a generic User-agent:* policy). Discovery: the top-level 'Collections' mega-nav dropdown links directly to 'Best Sellers' -> https://www.allmodern.com/curated/shop-our-best-sellers~ev554120.html, a genuine curated PLP (BlockBuilder Search-Browse page, real product grid with prices) whose embedded data-tracking-metadata carries resultCount:487, matching the visible on-page text '487 Items'. That same page itself links to one narrower genuine sub-listing, 'Best-Selling Furniture' (H1 'Best Selling Furniture'), reached via its event-ID URL https://www.allmodern.com/daily-sales/best-selling-furniture~e294316.html with its own resultCount:35 -- kept as a sibling row alongside the main 487 listing since 35 is a materially distinct, non-summing category cut (same overlap-is-expected principle as the site's category taxonomy). Note: the SAME 'best-selling-furniture' slug WITHOUT its event-ID suffix (bare https://www.allmodern.com/daily-sales/best-selling-furniture) resolves instead to a pageType 'DailySalesMajorPromo' shell with no resultCount at all -- that bare-slug variant was excluded as a non-listing promo redirect; only the ID-qualified, resultCount-bearing URL was kept. Also checked and excluded: several generic 'Shop Top-Rated ... Collections' promo-carousel tiles present on the Best Sellers page (Bedroom/Outdoor/Sofa+Sectional Collections, 'SHOP BY ROOM', 'Recently Viewed') -- these are cross-site marketing modules unrelated to the Bestsellers concept, not sub-categories. Checked footer link lists (About Us, Customer Service, Contact Us, Shopping Assistance) and the site's category+keyword XML sitemaps: no other Bestsellers-named entries found anywhere else on the site. AllModern is Wayfair-family (storeID 81) and uses the identical resultCount/BrowseGrid tracking-metadata evidence mechanism already documented for sibling Wayfair-family sites in this project.
